subject: geomorph 4.0.1 released on Github and CRAN

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: geomorph 4.0.1 released on Github and CRAN
parts:
Colleagues,

 

We wish to announce that an updated version of geomorph (4.0.1) is now available on Github (geomorphR/geomorph) and on CRAN.  This is a minor release with some small bug fixes, that largely updates support code to be compliant with base-R 4.1 updates.  Similar changes were made to RRPP, which contains underlying code for many geomorph functions. Thus, it is recommended that both package be updated for full functionality.

 

As always, the full list of updates and enhancements are found in the News file.


Best,


Dean and the geomorph team (Dean, Mike, Antigoni, Erica)

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams
